about.label: About Me
about.heading: Nice to meet you!
about.content: My journey isn't defined solely by lines of code. It's about curiosity, endurance, and the pursuit of the unknown.
about.long_bio: I stand at the convergence of hardware and software. As a Dual Degree student at BITS Pilani, I blend the analytical rigor of Theoretical Physics with the structural precision of Computer Science. Raised in the shadow of launchpads at Sriharikota, my passion for aerospace and robotics is innate. I don't just write code; I build systems that interact with the physical world—from designing Mars Rover avionics to architecting custom Quantum Computing IDEs.
